blocks.text: **Obesity** is a chronic, relapsing, multifactorial disease characterised by excessive or abnormal accumulation of body fat that may impair health.
It results from interactions between genetic, biological, environmental, behavioural, socioeconomic and metabolic factors.

blocks.text: Lifestyle intervention is the foundation of obesity management, including in patients receiving anti-obesity medication or undergoing bariatric surgery.
The primary objective is to establish a sustainable calorie deficit while maintaining adequate nutritional intake.

blocks.text: A practical adult approach is a deficit of approximately 500–750 kcal/day, individualised according to baseline energy requirements.

Exercise should be introduced gradually, particularly in patients with severe obesity, osteoarthritis or cardiovascular disease.
